title: Finite global dimension gives finite projective dimension of the residue field
statement: Let R be a local ring of finite global dimension. Then its residue field has finite projective dimension.

proof.text: Choose the uniform bound n from finite global dimension and apply it to ULift of the residue field, in the module universe max u v. Use the all-degrees clause of the bounded-resolution/Ext characterization to obtain Mathlib HasProjectiveDimensionLE for this lifted module.

Transport Mathlib HasProjectiveDimensionLE along ULift.moduleEquiv to the residue field in universe u using the linear-equivalence theorem. Apply the reverse all-degrees clause of the bounded-resolution/Ext characterization in universe u and retain the same bound n. This yields finite projective dimension.

proof_origin.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00OC, implication (2) => (1); Lean universe transport via the existing 065R characterization and Mathlib linear-equivalence invariance
